description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית
description.summary: This table outlines special conditions for Part II of a professional liability insurance policy, specifically regarding the calculation of indemnity and loss valuation. It details how losses are adjusted for inflation and currency exchange rates.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת תנאים מיוחדים לחלק השני של פוליסת ביטוח אחריות מקצועית ליועצי השקעות. הפוליסה מגדירה כיצד יחושב הפיצוי עבור הפסדים, כולל התייחסות להוצאות מימון, שינויים במדד המחירים לצרכן, והמרת סכומים לדולר אמריקאי. החישוב מתבסס על שער החליפין המייצג ביום גילוי ההפסד. מטרת הפוליסה היא לפצות את המבוטח על ההפסד הכספי הישיר שנגרם לו. תנאים אלו כוללים התייחסות להחזר עלויות הלוואות, מדד המחירים לצרכן, דולר אמריקאי, ושער החליפין.

description.column_axis: Details of the condition (e.g., inclusion of borrowing costs, index adjustment, currency conversion)

Loss adjustment: Date of loss incurred vs. date of discovery

SPECIAL CONDITIONS TO PART II
(b) To  include,  where  immediate  replacements  are  necessary,  as  in  the  case  of certificates  of  deposit  and  the  like,  the  cost  of  borrowing  money  in  order  to  obtain such replacement.
(c) The  nominal  amount  of  any  cash  or  monetary  loss  sustained  in  N.I.S.  shall  be adjusted  by  the  change  in  the  General  Price  Index  as  published  by  the  Central Bureau of Statistics    (hereinafter  the  "Index")  between  the  Index  prevailing,  on  the date when the loss incurred and the Index prevailing upon the date of discovery of the  loss.    This  basis  shall  apply  only  to  the  extent  that  a  quantifiable  loss  can  be established to have been sustained to the satisfaction of the Insurer, at a given  point in time during one or more of the above mentioned periods.
(d) The value of securities and/or the adjusted cash or monetary loss shall be
converted to US $ according to the Representative Rate of Exchange prevailing upon the date of discovery of the loss.
The intent of the Assured and the Insurer being that the valuation of any loss under this part  of  the  Policy  shall  represent,  insofar  ascertained,  the  actual  direct  financial  loss sustained by the Assured.

(c) The  nominal  amount  of  any  cash  or  monetary  loss  sustained  in  N.I.S.  shall  be adjusted  by  the  change  in  the  General  Price  Index  as  published  by  the  Central Bureau of Statistics    (hereinafter  the  "Index")  between  the  Index  prevailing,  on  the date when the loss incurred and the Index prevailing upon the date of discovery of the  loss.    This  basis  shall  apply  only  to  the  extent  that  a  quantifiable  loss  can  be established to have been sustained to the satisfaction of the Insurer, at a given  point in time during one or more of the above mentioned periods.
(d) The value of securities and/or the adjusted cash or monetary loss shall be
converted to US $ according to the Representative Rate of Exchange prevailing upon the date of discovery of the loss.
The intent of the Assured and the Insurer being that the valuation of any loss under this part  of  the  Policy  shall  represent,  insofar  ascertained,  the  actual  direct  financial  loss sustained by the Assured.
